technical_complexity.rationale: LLM scoring of call transcripts against methodologies such as MEDDPICC, built on Gong and Chorus data, was standard engineering with prompt design as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: The product sat on top of Gong and Chorus data, so the platforms could add the same scoring themselves.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows a platform copying Fabius. It was acquired by Fractional AI in February 2026.

market_need_then: The YC page states customers such as Airbyte and Fermat used it, and sales teams already paid for call recording tools. No revenue figures found.
